note: Each task runs inside the computer as the agent user with the agent seat's environment, HOME=$BENCH/home. setup creates files and starts the application; verify exits 0 only when the effect is there.

tasks.prompt: In the open Mousepad window, replace the whole text with "basalt 417 cinder" and save it as a new file named cinder-41.txt in the same Documents folder.

tasks.setup: mkdir -p $HOME/Documents; printf 'the granite and the granite again\n' > $HOME/Documents/notes.txt; start mousepad $HOME/Documents/notes.txt
tasks.prompt: In the open Mousepad window, use Find and Replace to replace every "granite" with "heron", then save the file.
tasks.verify: test "$(cat $HOME/Documents/notes.txt)" = 'the heron and the heron again'

tasks.setup: gsettings reset org.xfce.mousepad.preferences.view show-line-numbers; mkdir -p $HOME/Documents; printf 'hello\n' > $HOME/Documents/notes.txt; start mousepad $HOME/Documents/notes.txt
tasks.prompt: In the open Mousepad window, turn on line numbers in Mousepad's preferences.
In the open file manager window, create a new folder named Studio42 in the Documents folder it shows.
In the open file manager window, rename the file report.txt to summary-2026.txt.
In the open Thunar Preferences window, turn on "Text beside icons".
In the open Chromium window, fill the form: Recipient "Iris Moss", City "Granite Falls", tick Gift wrap, then press Ship order.

tasks.setup:
page $HOME/Documents/form.html 'Details' 'Claimed'; printf 'Welcome

Welcome

Help

Continue to the form

' > $HOME/Documents/start.html; start chromium --no-first-run --no-default-browser-check --user-data-dir=$HOME/chromium file://$HOME/Documents/start.html
tasks.prompt: In the open Chromium window, follow "Continue to the form", then fill Recipient "Iris Moss" and City "Granite Falls", tick Gift wrap and press Ship order.
In the open Firefox window, fill the form: Recipient "Iris Moss", City "Granite Falls", tick Gift wrap, then press Ship order.
In the open LibreOffice Writer window, type the text "Quarterly report for heron" and save the document in ODF format as report.odt in the Documents folder of the home directory.
tasks.verify: unzip -p $HOME/Documents/report.odt content.xml | grep -q 'Quarterly report for heron'

tasks.prompt: In the open LibreOffice Calc window, put 12 in A1, 30 in A2 and a formula adding them in A3, then save the spreadsheet in ODF format as sums.ods in the Documents folder of the home directory.
tasks.verify: unzip -p $HOME/Documents/sums.ods content.xml | grep -q 'of:=\[.A1\]+\[.A2\]' && unzip -p $HOME/Documents/sums.ods content.xml | grep -q '>42<'

tasks.prompt: In the open terminal window, run a command that writes the word fjord into a file named term.txt in the current directory.
In the open Visual Studio Code window, change the port in app.conf from 8080 to 9090 and save the file.
In the open KeePassXC window, create a new password database named Vault with the password "heron-basalt-42" and save it as vault.kdbx in the Documents folder of the home directory.
In the open Signup dialog, enter the Name "Iris Moss" and the City "Granite Falls", then confirm it with OK.
In the open Keyboard settings window, turn off the blinking text cursor.
In the open LibreOffice Impress window, start an empty presentation, give the first slide the title "Harbor plan" and save it in ODF format as plan.odp in the Documents folder of the home directory.
